apps.name: Broke
apps.versionDescription: Plan is now a month calendar. Swipe between tabs, and swipe any record to edit or delete it. Goals reorder by dragging and can log money you already paid. Bills and salary get mark-paid and skip. Wallet splits what you owe from what you are owed. Plus fixes for every bug you reported.
apps.localizedDescription: Broke keeps every wallet, transaction, goal, debt and bill in a database on this phone. No account, no login, no server - it works in airplane mode. 3ammo still has opinions about your spending.

versions.localizedDescription: Plan is now a month calendar. Swipe between tabs, and swipe any record to edit or delete it. Goals reorder by dragging and can log money you already paid. Bills and salary get mark-paid and skip. Wallet splits what you owe from what you are owed. Plus fixes for every bug you reported.
3ammo is now the app icon. First launch asks what to call you.
Offline-first: the phone is now the source of truth. Local database, no backend, no login. Mutual-debt offsetting, repeating bills, and a from-zero reset.
